item.title: BO NAGAR’S SURRENDER: Challenges and Lessons for Myanmar’s Resistance Forces
item.description: The surrender of Bo Nagar, leader of the Burma National Revolutionary Army (BNRA), to the Myanmar military junta on February 18, 2026, has profoundly unsettled the political climate and armed resistance movements within Myanmar. His defection, publicized by military-controlled media, occurred during heightened clashes between his forces and those loyal to the National Unity Government […] The post BO NAGAR’S SURRENDER: Challenges and Lessons for Myanmar’s Resistance Forces appeared first on Shan
